title: Morning Routine
description: Each morning, the lifeguards on Haeundae Beach in Busan, one of South Korea’s most popular summer destinations, perform an elaborate series of stretches, group runs, and rescue drills. Photographer Forrest Walker encountered this crew as they finished a swim workout. “The beach felt more like a training ground,” Walker says, “with a quiet discipline.” That is, until the lifeguards assumed their posts—and the sunbathing masses began to gather. This photo is featured in the "In Focus" series in the July 2026 issue of National Geographic.
translated_description: 每天清晨，韩国最受欢迎的夏季旅游胜地之一——釜山海云台海滩的救生员们，都会进行一系列精心编排的拉伸、集体跑步和救援演练。摄影师福雷斯特·沃克在他们完成游泳训练时遇到了这支队伍。“海滩更像一个训练场，”沃克说，“带着一种安静的纪律感。”直到救生员们各就各位——而享受日光浴的人群开始聚集。这张照片刊登在《国家地理》2026年7月刊的“聚焦”系列中。
